text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell tool here. Please run it to confirm everything passes. I checked each fix against what its test expects.

- `fees.py`: the fee was the number of days *plus* the daily rate; it's now days *times* the rate, so 4 days late costs 1.00.
- `members.py`: the borrowing limit was 3, but the policy comment and tests say 5. I set `MAX_BORROWED = 5`.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned one event too many; it now returns the last `n`. I also made it return an empty list when `n <= 0`, which the tests didn't ask for.
- `factory.py`: added the missing `Emma` book so the sample set has all three titles.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` now turns the year into a number, so `age()` works.
- `search.py`: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports it from `catalog.text`.

I didn't change any tests.
